name: Full Portal Overhaul
description:
Build ALL 10 waves of the ASU Medical Portal improvement plan in one overnight session:

1. Install missing dependencies (zustand, zod, vite-plugin-pwa)
2. Download and normalize 5 Freesound samples
3. Expand Question types with difficulty, bloomLevel, tags, estimatedTimeSeconds, media
4. Add Zod runtime validation schemas
5. Add heuristic difficulty/bloom assignment at data load time
6. Fix remaining `any` types in data.ts
7. Build sound engine with 5 samples + mute toggle
8. Add micro-interactions on all buttons (scale, hover glow, active press)
9. Add custom cursor for desktop (glowing orb, color shift)
10. Build countdown timer hook with exam/practice/off modes
11. Build circular SVG timer ring with urgency colors
12. Add exam mode settings panel (20/40/60/80 question count)
13. Build gamification store (XP, level, streak) with Zustand + persist
14. Add XP/streak/level HUD in quiz interface
15. Add daily streak heatmap calendar (GitHub-style)
16. Add "weakest topics" auto-recommendation card
17. Add module-themed confetti (color-coded per module)
18. Add 3D card flip reveal on answer
19. Add glassmorphism dashboard cards with hover lift
20. Add module completion ring charts
21. Add global prefers-reduced-motion support
22. Add aria-live quiz announcements for screen readers
23. Add focus traps in overlays
24. Expand service worker precache with workbox manifest
25. Add route prefetching
26. Add loading skeletons for async content

After ALL waves are built, run a full recheck: npm test, npm run build, npx tsc --noEmit, review all new files, verify no dangling threads, no TODOs, no placeholders.

Every wave must independently build + test + commit. No wave proceeds until its verification gate passes.

goal.answer: Ship all 8 feature waves (setup, schema, sound, timer, gamification, design polish, accessibility, performance) plus final recheck in one overnight autonomous session. Every wave commits independently, builds, passes tests, and is documented. If a wave fails, auto-retry 3 times then log and skip. No human checkpoints. One morning summary report.

criteria.answer:
npm list zustand zod vite-plugin-pwa exits 0 — all dependencies installed
public/sounds/ contains exactly 5 MP3 files
npm test passes >150 tests across all suites with zero failures
npx tsc --noEmit returns zero TypeScript errors
npm run build produces a clean production bundle
Zero explicit any types remain in src/app/data.ts
Question interface in types.ts contains difficulty, bloomLevel, tags, estimatedTimeSeconds, media fields
Zod schema rejects placeholder explanations and invalid difficulty values
Sound engine starts unmuted, toggles mute, persists mute state to localStorage
Timer ring SVG renders correct urgency color progression green→amber→red→critical
Gamification store tracks XP, levels up at thresholds, extends streak on consecutive days
StreakCalendar renders 16-week GitHub-style heatmap
ModuleCompletionRing renders SVG ring with percentage label
Global reduced-motion CSS disables all animations via prefers-reduced-motion
aria-live region announces quiz answer states to screen readers
Service Worker precaches all JS/CSS chunks via workbox manifest
Review report written to .kimchi/docs/review-report.md with zero critical issues
All new files have test coverage >=70%
Zero TODO/FIXME/HACK placeholders exist in any source file
Every wave committed with atomic commit message and verification gate passes

constraints.answer: All schema changes must be additive — no breaking changes to existing JSON banks, Every commit must be atomic and independently revertable, All tests must pass before any phase ships (retry 3x if needed, then log and skip), Sound is ON by default — mute toggle must work on first click, Zero student-facing configuration for difficulty (backend-only), Apple/Spotify aesthetic maintained throughout — no heavy amber accents, Build must pass (npx tsc --noEmit + npm run build) after every wave, No TODOs, placeholders, or 'implement later' comments in shipped code

phases.answer: Phase 1: Setup + Schema Foundation, Phase 2: Sound + Micro-interactions, Phase 3: Timer + Gamification, Phase 4: Design Polish + Smart Topics, Phase 5: Accessibility + Performance, Phase 6: Final Review

assumptions.answer: JSON bank files are not modified (additive-only schema changes); NVIDIA LLaMA 3.1 free tier remains available for AI batch difficulty refinement (optional, not blocking); Freesound.org CC0 samples are available for download; Student device supports modern CSS (3D transforms, backdrop-filter); Browser autoplay policies allow Audio() after first user gesture; If a wave fails build/tests, auto-retry 3 times then skip to next wave with failure logged; Overnight run is fully autonomous — no human checkpoints between phases; Sound samples must match Apple/Spotify aesthetic (clean, minimal, not jarring)
